errors.text: The proposed CoCrFeNi-Al-WC system replaces the target MgAlTiVFeCo alloy and therefore cannot reconstruct its BCC precursor, Mg-sensitive processing window, or characteristic oxide phases.
The proposed 1000–1100 °C SPS window exceeds the target upper limit of 1000 °C, above which magnesium volatilization is a critical constraint.

The falsification experiment varies WC content rather than sintering temperature, so it does not test whether the 1000 °C densification and barrier-phase precipitation mechanism outperforms lower-temperature processing.
The predicted hardness above 450 HV is far below the target result of 1235.5 HV, and no quantitative relative-density prediction corresponding to 96.7% is supplied.
